Class DynamicConnectivity

java.lang.Object
structures.DynamicConnectivity
All Implemented Interfaces:
Connectivity
public class DynamicConnectivity extends Object implements Connectivity
Fully dynamic connectivity for an undirected graph (Holm, de Lichtenberg and Thorup, 2001). Vertices and edges can be added and removed in any order.

Amortized complexity: O(log^2 n) per edge insertion or deletion, O(log n) for connected(long, long), O(1) for componentCount().

This class only contains the level logic of the algorithm. The Euler tour trees live in EulerTourForest, the treap in Treap, and the per-level bookkeeping in ConnectivityLevel.
